findings.issue: רַע is an adjective masculine singular absolute; postposed mal is naturally the adverb “badly,” which narrows the open adjective toward manner.
בְּקְצֵה is בְּ plus the construct noun “end/edge” of the camp; en extremo is also the degree adverb “extremely,” which would add intensity and read del campamento as partitive “from the camp.”

notes: Wayyiqtol chain, Jehová, nariz, fuego, and comió match the tokens; both warns are ambiguous Spanish, not extra concepts forced by the wording.
